CIP code -> Program Name (Program_Code displayformat [Name]), SIUD (141) rows only. Programs with a unique official CIP resolve directly. 52.0201 (MBA/BBA): resolved by App_Student_Major if it equals the program name, else by App_Target_Degree_Level (MB/MS -> MASTER, BA -> BACHELOR). Catch-all codes ending .9999 (all newer programs) can't be resolved from the CIP -- App_Student_Major must hold the exact program name (e.g. 'BACHELOR OF COMMERCE'); otherwise the row is flagged. Never blanked, because Student_program is mandatory.
